candidates.tagline: Amazon promised precision delivery — it landed in the pool
candidates.story: Amazon's Prime Air MK30 drone autonomously dropped a customer's package into her backyard swimming pool in Richmond, Texas on August 17, 2026 — then Amazon announced its biggest-ever expansion to 500 U.S. cities just two days later.
candidates.why_funny: A delivery system sold specifically on its precision couldn't distinguish 'lawn' from 'pool,' then the company celebrated with a press release about bringing this technology to 30 million more customers.
candidates.alt: Amazon Prime Air MK30 delivery drone hovering low over a residential house rooftop against a blue sky

candidates.tagline: Google said '3x stronger' — it snapped in exactly the same place. Again.
candidates.story: The Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold cracked at the antenna-line hinge weakness in JerryRigEverything's bend test on August 21, 2026 — the fourth consecutive Google foldable to fail at the identical structural point, despite Google marketing it as 'three times stronger.'
candidates.why_funny: After four generations of the same phone breaking in the same spot, Google shipped the next one with a '3x stronger' press release — and it broke in the same spot.
candidates.alt: Pixel 11 Pro Fold after JerryRigEverything durability test, with the front display panel completely detached from the hinge, the device splayed open and visibly destroyed on a workbench
